name: Xiaoma 1
summary: Xiaoma 1 is a humanoid visitor-service robot developed through Jinma Matrix, Jinma’s controlled venture with Shanghai Matrix. It is intended for theme parks, scenic attractions and commercial complexes, with interactive and multilingual visitor assistance. The launch photograph shows a standing humanoid with two articulated arms and hands. Jinma publicly launched the model in November 2025; current commercial delivery status for this exact model has not been verified.
